content: If your laundry room feels more like a chaotic pile of detergent bottles and mismatched socks than a functional space, you're not alone. The good news? **Laundry room organization IKEA** solutions are some of the most affordable, stylish, and effective ways to completely transform this often-overlooked area of your home. In 2026, IKEA continues to dominate the home organization space — and for good reason. With modular systems, budget-friendly pricing, and that signature Scandinavian minimalism, IKEA makes it remarkably easy to build a laundry room that actually works. Whether you have a spacious dedicated laundry room or a tiny closet-sized nook, this comprehensive review and guide will walk you through the best IKEA products and layout ideas to organize your laundry space once and for all.
![Organized laundry room with IKEA white cabinets and open shelving storage solutions 2026](/images/blog/laundry-room-organization-ikea-smart-ideas-transform-space-2026-hero.webp)
## Why IKEA Is the Go-To Brand for Laundry Room Organization

When it comes to home organization, few brands offer the combination of **affordability, modularity, and aesthetic appeal** that IKEA does. According to [The Spruce](https://www.thespruce.com), modular shelving systems are among the most popular laundry room upgrades because they allow homeowners to customize storage based on their exact space and needs — something IKEA has mastered.
Here's why so many homeowners turn to IKEA for their laundry room organization needs in 2026:
• **Affordable pricing** — Most IKEA laundry organization systems start at around $9.99 for individual components, making full room transformations possible on a budget of $100–$300
• **Modular design** — Systems like ALGOT, BOAXEL, and SEKTION can be mixed, matched, and expanded over time
• **Clean Scandinavian aesthetic** — White and light grey finishes create a bright, airy feeling even in windowless laundry rooms
• **Durability** — IKEA's wire and coated steel components are moisture-resistant, which is critical in a laundry environment
• **Nationwide availability** — Available in over 60 countries, making IKEA solutions truly accessible to an international audience
> Studies show that a well-organized laundry room can reduce the time spent on laundry-related tasks by up to 30%, simply by having dedicated zones for sorting, washing, folding, and storing.
If you're ready to take your laundry space from chaotic to calm, let's dive into the specific IKEA systems and products that deliver the best results.

## The Best IKEA Systems for Laundry Room Organization

IKEA offers several modular systems that are perfectly suited for laundry rooms. Each one has unique strengths depending on your space, budget, and storage priorities. Here's an in-depth review of the top IKEA systems to use in 2026:

![IKEA KALLAX and SEKTION cabinets used for laundry room organization with labeled storage bins](/images/blog/laundry-room-organization-ikea-smart-ideas-transform-space-2026-ikea-cabinets-laundry.webp)
### 1. IKEA ALGOT / BOAXEL Wall Upright System

The **BOAXEL system** (which replaced ALGOT in many markets) is arguably IKEA's most versatile laundry room solution. It mounts directly to the wall and uses a simple hook-in system that requires no tools after the initial wall mount is installed.
• Wall uprights: starting at **$15.00**
• Wire baskets (various sizes): **$8.00–$20.00** each
• Pull-out laundry bags: **$25.00**
• Hanging rod add-ons: **$10.00**

**Best for:** Renters and homeowners who want a flexible, wall-mounted solution that can be reconfigured easily. The wire baskets allow air circulation — perfect for storing damp items or freshly washed laundry.
### 2. IKEA SEKTION Kitchen Cabinet System

Don't let the name fool you — the **SEKTION cabinet system** works brilliantly in laundry rooms. Many interior designers recommend it for creating a built-in look at a fraction of custom cabinetry costs.
• Base cabinet (30"W x 30"H): starting at **$89.00**
• Wall cabinet (30"W x 15"H): starting at **$49.00**
• Door styles and finishes: available in 20+ options
**Best for:** Homeowners who want a polished, kitchen-style look in their laundry room with hidden storage for detergents, cleaning supplies, and miscellaneous items.
### 3. IKEA KALLAX Shelf Unit
The iconic **KALLAX shelf** isn't just for living rooms and home offices — it's a laundry room powerhouse when used correctly.
• Compatible fabric boxes (DRÖNA): **$7.99** each
**Best for:** Storing folded laundry, sorting bins, and laundry accessories in fabric or wicker inserts. The DRÖNA fabric boxes come in 10+ colors, making color-coded sorting a breeze.
### 4. IKEA RÅSKOG Utility Cart
The **RÅSKOG cart** is a budget-friendly, mobile laundry helper that punches well above its $29.99 price point.
• Three-tier design with wire mesh shelves
• Available in white, turquoise, dark grey
• Easy to roll between washer and dryer
**Best for:** Storing laundry supplies like detergent, stain removers, dryer sheets, and fabric softener in a portable unit that can be tucked away when not in use.

## IKEA Laundry Room Organization Ideas by Space Size

One of the most common challenges with laundry room organization is that spaces vary wildly in size. Here's how to apply **laundry room organization IKEA** principles based on how much room you're working with:
![IKEA wall-mounted shelves with wire baskets and glass jars for laundry room organization](/images/blog/laundry-room-organization-ikea-smart-ideas-transform-space-2026-ikea-shelving-laundry.webp)
### Small Laundry Closets (Under 20 sq ft)
In a tight laundry closet, vertical space is your best friend. IKEA's wall-mounted systems shine here.
1. Mount a **BOAXEL wall upright** on the wall above the washer/dryer
2. Add two to three **wire shelves** for detergents and supplies
3. Install a **pull-out laundry bag** on the BOAXEL system to replace a freestanding hamper
4. Use a **GRUNDTAL magnetic knife strip** (yes, the kitchen one!) on the inside of the closet door to hold small metal accessories
5. Add a **BEKVÄM step stool** that tucks beneath the bottom shelf when not in use
**Space saved:** Up to 40% more floor space compared to using freestanding storage furniture.
### Medium Laundry Rooms (20–60 sq ft)
A medium laundry room offers enough room to create distinct zones — sorting, washing, folding, and storing.
1. Install **SEKTION base cabinets** along one wall for hidden storage
2. Add a **butcher block countertop** (IKEA BADELUNDA or similar) over the cabinets for a dedicated folding station
3. Mount **BOAXEL shelving** above the countertop for frequently accessed items
4. Position a **KALLAX 2x2 unit** in a corner as a sorting station using DRÖNA fabric boxes labeled for whites, colors, and darks
5. Hang a **GRUNDTAL wall rail** for drying small garments and accessories
### Spacious Laundry Rooms (60+ sq ft)
Lucky enough to have a generous laundry room? Here's how to make the most of every square foot:
1. Build a full wall of **SEKTION cabinets** combining upper wall cabinets and lower base cabinets
2. Create a long **folding and ironing station** with a pull-out ironing board insert (available as a SEKTION cabinet accessory)
3. Install a **BOAXEL hanging rod** section for air-drying clothes
4. Add a **RÅSKOG cart** on wheels for mobile supply storage
5. Incorporate a **KALLAX 4x2 unit** as a room divider or accent wall for stylish basket storage

## IKEA Laundry Room Organization Hacks and Pro Tips
Beyond the standard product use, experienced home organizers have discovered clever ways to maximize IKEA products for laundry rooms. Here are some of the most effective hacks for 2026:
![Small laundry room organization with IKEA over-washer shelving and pull-out hampers 2026](/images/blog/laundry-room-organization-ikea-smart-ideas-transform-space-2026-small-laundry-room-ikea.webp)
### Use IKEA Kitchen Accessories in Your Laundry Room
IKEA's kitchen line is massive — and much of it translates perfectly to laundry rooms:
• **VARIERA shelf insert** ($9.99): Use it inside cabinets to double the vertical storage space for detergent bottles
• **STÖDJA pot lid organizer** ($8.99): Repurpose it to hold wrapping paper rolls, lint rollers, or ironing supplies upright
• **GRUNDTAL spice rack** ($14.99): Mount inside a cabinet door to store small laundry pods, stain sticks, and safety pins
• **TILLREDA magnetic knife strip**: Perfect for holding small metal clips, safety pins, and bobby pins that would otherwise get lost
### Label Everything with IKEA KVISSLE Labels

A consistent labeling system transforms a good organization setup into a great one. IKEA's **KVISSLE label holders** ($6.99 for a pack) clip onto baskets and bins throughout the BOAXEL and KALLAX systems. Research from [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com) suggests that labeled storage systems reduce the time spent searching for items by up to 25%.
### Install a Folding Station at the Right Height

According to ergonomic guidelines, the ideal folding station height is **34–36 inches** — the same as a standard kitchen counter. IKEA SEKTION base cabinets are designed for exactly this height, making them a perfect laundry folding station base.
### Create a Lost Socks Station

Mount a small **SKÅDIS pegboard** ($14.99) on the wall beside your dryer. Attach small hooks and hang mismatched socks until their pair turns up. It sounds simple, but it eliminates the frustration of sock matching entirely.
### Use NYMÅNE LED Lighting
Many laundry rooms suffer from poor lighting. IKEA's **NYMÅNE LED work lamp** ($49.99) can be mounted under cabinets to brighten your folding station, making it easier to spot stains before they set.
## How to Plan Your IKEA Laundry Room Layout Step by Step
Planning is everything when it comes to **IKEA laundry room organization**. Here's a step-by-step approach to designing your perfect setup:
1. **Measure your space accurately** — Record the width, depth, and height of all walls, noting door swings, window placements, and outlet positions
2. **Use IKEA's free planning tool** — IKEA offers a free online room planner specifically for their cabinet systems, allowing you to visualize the layout before purchasing
3. **Define your zones** — Every laundry room should have at minimum: a sorting zone, a washing zone, a drying zone, and a folding/storage zone
4. **Prioritize vertical storage** — In any laundry room under 60 sq ft, wall-mounted systems should be your primary storage strategy
5. **Choose your primary system first** — Decide between BOAXEL (flexible, affordable) or SEKTION (polished, permanent) as your foundation
6. **Add supplementary items** — Once your main system is planned, layer in RÅSKOG carts, KALLAX units, and individual accessories
7. **Plan for a laundry hamper solution** — Whether it's pull-out BOAXEL laundry bags or DRÖNA boxes in a KALLAX, build hamper space into your plan from the start
8. **Budget thoughtfully** — A complete IKEA laundry room makeover typically costs **$150–$500 depending on room size**, making it one of the most cost-effective home upgrades available

## FAQ: Frequently Asked Questions About Laundry Room Organization IKEA
**Q: Which IKEA system is best for a very small laundry closet?**

The **BOAXEL wall upright system** is the best choice for small laundry closets because it mounts directly to the wall and uses vertical space efficiently. You can add pull-out laundry bags, wire shelves, and hanging rods in a space as narrow as 24 inches wide. Starting at around $15 per component, it's also the most budget-friendly option for tight spaces.
**Q: Can I use IKEA kitchen cabinets (SEKTION) in a laundry room?**

Absolutely! IKEA SEKTION cabinets are designed for high-humidity kitchen environments, which makes them equally well-suited for laundry rooms. They're moisture-resistant, durable, and available in dozens of door styles and colors. Many professional organizers actually recommend them for laundry rooms specifically because they create a polished, built-in look at a significantly lower cost than custom cabinetry.
**Q: How do I make my IKEA laundry organization look more stylish?**

A few simple upgrades make a big difference: (1) Swap out standard IKEA hardware for matte black or brass pulls — this alone transforms the look. (2) Use matching fabric boxes (DRÖNA or TJENA) in a consistent color palette. (3) Add a small potted plant on an open shelf for warmth. (4) Install under-cabinet LED strip lighting for a boutique feel. (5) Use a uniform label system with a label maker for a professional finish.
**Q: Is it possible to do laundry room organization with IKEA on a $100 budget?**

Yes! A tight $100 budget can go a long way with IKEA. Prioritize: a RÅSKOG utility cart ($29.99) for supply storage, a set of DRÖNA fabric boxes in a KALLAX you may already own (4 boxes for $31.96), and a BOAXEL shelf or two (around $30). This combination gives you a mobile supply station, color-coded sorting bins, and at least one wall shelf — covering all the basics of a functional laundry organization system.
**Q: How do I stop my laundry room from smelling damp with IKEA storage?**

Choose **wire mesh storage** (BOAXEL wire baskets) over enclosed fabric or solid bins wherever possible. Wire allows airflow, which prevents moisture buildup and musty odors. Also ensure your dryer is properly vented, run a dehumidifier if needed, and use open shelving rather than closed cabinets for storing freshly washed items until fully dry.
**Q: What IKEA products work best for storing laundry detergent and supplies?**

The **RÅSKOG cart** is ideal for laundry supply storage — it holds bottles, pods, dryer sheets, and stain removers all in one rolling unit. For a wall-mounted option, the **BOAXEL shelves** with raised edges keep bottles from sliding. For a concealed approach, a **SEKTION base cabinet** keeps supplies completely hidden for a cleaner look.
